hook.name: UniHooks Shared Hook
hook.description: Shared launch hook where each pool configures its own rules at initialization (allowlist, trading start, anti-snipe window, buy burn, LP rewards, sell tax, treasury fee, wallet cap, same-block guard, exit decay, volatility fee, sandwich guard). Takes a fixed 0.10% platform fee on every swap in the paired asset; additional fees are routed via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta.
